name: react-native-nitro-input
description: Native text for React Native, built with Nitro: a text and amount input with native formatting, masks and a Torph-style reflow, and an animated number (odometer, SwiftUI-style numeric text, ticker) whose digits roll or swap natively, with currency layouts and animated currency switches, shrink-to-fit, a loading shimmer and a jackpot reveal.

scripts.build: rm -rf lib && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.build.cjs.json && echo '{"type":"module"}' > lib/module/package.json
scripts.test:cpp: mkdir -p .cache && clang++ -std=c++20 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Icpp cpp/ReflowEngine.cpp cpp/AmountFormatter.cpp cpp/__tests__/ReflowEngineTest.cpp -o .cache/reflow-engine-test && .cache/reflow-engine-test && clang++ -std=c++20 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Icpp cpp/AmountFormatter.cpp cpp/__tests__/AmountFormatterTest.cpp -o .cache/amount-formatter-test && .cache/amount-formatter-test && clang++ -std=c++20 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Icpp cpp/AmountFormatter.cpp cpp/MaskEngine.cpp cpp/__tests__/MaskEngineTest.cpp -o .cache/mask-engine-test && .cache/mask-engine-test && clang++ -std=c++20 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Icpp cpp/OutlineGeometry.cpp cpp/__tests__/OutlineGeometryTest.cpp -o .cache/outline-geometry-test && .cache/outline-geometry-test && clang++ -std=c++20 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Icpp cpp/RollingEngine.cpp cpp/__tests__/RollingEngineTest.cpp -o .cache/rolling-engine-test && .cache/rolling-engine-test && clang++ -std=c++20 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Icpp cpp/numberformat/NumberFormatCore.cpp cpp/__tests__/NumberFormatCoreTest.cpp -o .cache/number-format-core-test && .cache/number-format-core-test && clang++ -std=c++20 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Icpp cpp/numberformat/NumberFormatCore.cpp cpp/numberformat/NumberFormatProbe.cpp cpp/__tests__/NumberFormatProbeTest.cpp -o .cache/number-format-probe-test && .cache/number-format-probe-test

author: Ronald Goedeke
